title: NYSEG and RG&E Rebates 2026: Clean Heat Heat Pump and Water Heater Amounts
desc: NYSEG and RG&E share one Clean Heat table. See what each pays for heat pumps and water heaters from September 1, 2026 and why NYSEG's page still shows older figures.
lead: NYSEG covers much of upstate and the Southern Tier and RG&E covers Rochester. Both are owned by the same parent and pay from an identical table, so one page covers both. NYSEG's website still showed the pre-September figures on October 3, 2026.
cards_heading: What NYSEG and RG&E pay in 2026
cards_intro: The table is the same for both utilities. Pick the one on your electric bill; your project is submitted under that utility.

cards.title: NYSEG air-source heat pump
cards.note: Non-DAC: Category 2 $4,000 ($8,000 Weatherized Tier); 2b $7,000 ($12,000). DAC: Category 2 $5,000 ($9,000); 2b $8,000 ($13,000). Apartments about half. Partial to full load $3,000, or $1,500 for an apartment.

cards.title: RG&E air-source heat pump
cards.note: The same table as NYSEG, applied to Rochester-area electric customers.

cards.title: Ground-source retrofit
cards.note: $15,000, or $20,000 in the Weatherized Tier, outside a disadvantaged community; $16,000 or $21,000 inside one.

cards.title: Heat pump water heater
cards.note: A limited-time offer from September 1 to November 30, 2026 raises distributor and installer payments.

cards.title: Weatherized Tier
cards.note: Reached by building after 2010, past participation in an approved weatherization program such as NYSEG and RG&E Home Insulation and Air Sealing, or a heating-load test.

after_cards: NYSEG's own page showed up to $10,000 for air-source and up to $18,000 for ground-source on October 3, 2026. Those are the earlier amounts. The manual governs the contractor's submission.
sections: RG&E and NYSEG are separate utilities with separate service territories, so the first thing to check is the name on your bill. Rochester city and parts of Monroe County are RG&E. Many surrounding towns and the Southern Tier are NYSEG. The Clean Heat amounts do not differ between them, but a contractor registered for one may need to submit under the other.

NYSERDA maps disadvantaged communities by census tract. If your address is in one, the DAC column applies and the cap rises from 70% to 85% of project cost. The lookup is on NYSERDA's disadvantaged communities page, and a contractor can check it for you. A household can live next to a DAC tract and not be in one, so check the address instead of assuming.
Heat pump water heaters in the limited-time window

From September 1 to November 30, 2026 the utility raises what distributors and installers are paid on water heaters. The homeowner figure is $1,250, so the offer helps most when the installer's price drops with the extra payment. Ask for a quote with and without the offer. A homeowner can apply directly and install a unit themselves if codes are followed, though installers must be NYS licensed.

Because the Weatherized Tier pays up to $4,000 more for the same equipment, sealing first is worth pricing. NYSEG and RG&E run a Home Insulation and Air Sealing program that counts, and NYSERDA's Comfort Home pays $2,500 to $3,000 for seal-and-insulate packages. Ask whether finishing one of them before the heat pump qualifies the home.
claim_heading: How to claim NYSEG or RG&E Clean Heat
claim_steps: Find the utility on your electric bill: NYSEG or RG&E.
Check whether your address is in a disadvantaged community.
Request quotes from NYS Clean Heat participating contractors and ask which category and tier each quote uses.
Make sure the quote includes a Manual J load calculation.
The contractor submits the project and shows the incentive on your invoice.
cities: RG&E territory. Our existing Rochester page sits with the upstate hub.
faq: Do NYSEG and RG&E pay the same?
Yes. The manual lists identical amounts for both.
Why is the NYSEG website different?
It still showed the pre-September figures on October 3, 2026.
How much more does the Weatherized Tier pay?
$4,000 more on Category 2 and $5,000 more on 2b for a single-family non-DAC home.
What is the water heater offer?
$1,250, with a limited-time offer from September 1 to November 30, 2026 that raises distributor and installer payments.
Ask the contractor; stacking rules vary, and NYSERDA sets them.
